text: Karoline Kunstmayr you got me wrong haha I agree with most you said, just the financial side, if she is coming from Zurich or Geneva, life in TLV will not shock her in terms of cost, it will be even better for her. And many people have “normal” jobs in TLV, you don’t need to earn 50 000 shekels per month to survive haha that’s just what I meant and I used to live close to Geneva until recently and have been to Vienna few times over the last months, that’s why I also allow myself to give my opinion :) and yes amazing people here and the vibes are completely different and more warm ! Can only recommend to move ! 😊
